title: Do Not Drink Advisory Issued for Toledo Area

fields.label: breaking
fields.headline: Do Not Drink advisory issued for Toledo area after treatment plant problem
fields.dek: Residents are told not to drink tap water or use it for baby formula until further notice. City officials have not said when the advisory will end.
fields.heroImageBrief: aerial view of Toledo cityscape with water tower in foreground, overcast morning sky
fields.heroCaption: Toledo residents are advised to avoid tap water after a disruption at the city's treatment plant.
fields.heroCredit: Tina R. Cole / Glass City Courier
fields.body:
TOLEDO — The City of Toledo Department of Public Utilities has issued a Do Not Drink advisory for the entire service area following a disruption at the regional water treatment plant.

The advisory, effective immediately, warns residents not to consume tap water or use it for baby formula, brushing teeth, or food preparation. The city says pressure remains normal and there is no boil notice, but the water is unsafe for ingestion.

Officials have not disclosed the cause of the disruption, but say the issue occurred during routine maintenance and that the full extent of the problem is still under investigation. A city spokesperson said the advisory will remain in effect until further notice.

Hospitals across the city, including Ottawa River Regional Medical Center, have activated emergency plans. The medical center has confirmed that outpatient dialysis appointments are being rescheduled, and patients are urged to contact the facility directly for updates.

The city has activated its emergency supply chain, and bottled water is being distributed at designated points across the city. Residents are advised to use bottled water for all consumption and hygiene needs until the advisory is lifted.

The Ohio Department of Health has been notified and is monitoring the situation. State officials say they are coordinating with local agencies to ensure public safety and to track any potential health effects.

A follow-up statement from the city is expected later today.

This is a developing story. Check glasscitycourier.example for updates.
